property_summary: For any target and amount, when the callee's fallback consumes more than 2300 gas (so a .send would fail) but does not revert, the reference's low-level call forwards full gas and succeeds transferring Ether without reverting the outer call; the mutant using send will fail to transfer and thus revert due to require — so for some fuzzed amount/target the mutant reverts while the reference does not.
change_summary: Change the low-level call to use send (which returns false on failure and forwards 2300 gas) instead of call, affecting whether the target receives funds and whether failures revert outer call.
